description: Accelerates secp256r1 multiplication by replacing the entire uECC_vli_mult function with a single 256x256->512-bit multiplier.

instructions.name: secp256r1_mult
instructions.semantics: Performs a full 256x256-bit to 512-bit multiplication, replacing the entire uECC_vli_mult function. The input block (16 words) contains two 256-bit operands: `left` in `in[0..7]` and `right` in `in[8..15]`. The output block (16 words) contains the 512-bit product in `out[0..15]`.

name: secp256r1_accel
tests: link1: coverage 100.00% >= 80%; 1/1 C models built and survived 100,000 vectors under ASan+UBSan
gate2: 1/1 instructions: C model and patched Spike agree on 100,000 random + corner vectors
